title: Infantino Dodges Questions on His Future at U20 Women's World Cup Opening in Poland
detail: FIFA president Gianni Infantino attended the opening match of the U20 Women's World Cup (Poland vs. Argentina) in Katowice, Poland, but declined to address his political future when questioned by reporters. 'There will be a lot to say, but there will be a right place and a right time to say this. It's not today, it's not here,' he told Sky News. The appearance came amid mounting pressure from UEFA and other confederations to abandon his re-election bid, potential Swiss criminal proceedings tied to the abandoned World Cup stake-sale plan, and continuing fallout from Thrive Capital's Josh Kushner publicly airing regret over the deal days earlier. Al Jazeera characterized Infantino as facing 'growing uncertainty' ahead of the March 18, 2027 FIFA presidential election in Rabat.

media.caption: Gianni Infantino at the U20 Women's World Cup opening in Katowice, Poland, where he avoided questions about his FIFA future
